text:
Maya Patel: Hey team — quick sync. I want to launch a tiny hands-on refapp series next week focused on 'LLM inference for product teams' that includes a 10-min micro-tutorial, a short benchmark callout, and a CTA to the repo/license. Goal: community adoption + a measurable spike in OSS star/watchers.

Samir Rao: love it. timeline?

Maya Patel: aiming to publish 1 micro-tutorial/day Mon-Wed next week, with a consolidated benchmark post + short explainer on Thurs. webinar optional.

Olivia Chen: can we reuse the small inference demo from the refkit but tweak prompts to show latency/cost tradeoffs? keep it <5 files.

Alejandro: yes — I can PR a trimmed demo that runs on CPU + quantized model; add a small script that prints tokens/sec and estimated $/1k tokens.

Jamie (DevRel): +1. For messaging, we should lead with "what you can build in 15 minutes" and then put the benchmark as "real-world numbers" so it's not techy-first. Also add a quick how-to for routing inbound leads to the community form.

Maya Patel: good call. Samir — can you own the benchmark run (scripts + one chart)? Olivia/Jamie collaborate on the tutorial copy + short video gif. Alejandro handles the demo PR and a one-command run.

Samir Rao: can do. I'll run three configs: hosted (small host credits), dedicated-sim (local batch=8), and quantized local. Will output CSV and a 1-paragraph summary for marketing copy. ETA Tue EOD.

Olivia Chen: I'll draft the tutorial (steps, CLI, expected output) and a 30s screen-capture. Need a short checklist for what to record.

Jamie (DevRel): I'll write the post copy + social hooks. Suggest: "From prototype to production: 3 tiny tutorials that show latency, cost, and how to route traffic". Also will prepare the inbound routing flow: GH issue template -> demo request form -> community channel -> sales alert (if enterprise domain).

Alejandro: PR will include: Dockerfile (optional), run.sh, benchmark.sh and a small README. I'll add a note on model pins + quant settings.

devrel-bot: Reminder set: publish-draft-review at 1969998900 (team review).

Maya Patel: blockers?

Samir Rao: might need a small GPU credit for the hosted run. @finance can we get $50 in credits for this run?

Maya Patel: pinged finance offline.

Olivia Chen: also need an archived permalink for the demos folder — can someone create the repo subfolder and give me write access?

Alejandro: I'll create sources/refapp/micro-launch branch and add you.

Jamie (DevRel): timeline recap: 
- Mon: micro-tutorial #1 (intro + demo)
- Tue: micro-tutorial #2 (routing + embeddings) + benchmark CSV publish
- Wed: micro-tutorial #3 (quant + cost) + 30s gifs
- Thu: consolidated benchmark + long-form post + inbound routing config

Maya Patel: perfect. I'll schedule the review at 1969998900 and hold a 20-min sync Tue morning if anyone wants to hop on.

Samir Rao: small ask — can marketing include an inline chart image and a raw CSV in the blog assets? makes it easier for folks to reproduce.

Jamie (DevRel): yes — we'll host the CSV in the repo and embed the chart as an asset. Also will add a short reproducibility section.

Maya Patel: thanks all. I'll convert this thread into a quick checklist in Notion and tag folks. :sparkles:

Alejandro: :thumbsup:

Olivia Chen: thanks! I'll start drafting.

Jamie (DevRel): I'll draft the social and submit for review by Wed morning.

devrel-bot: Action required: review requested by Maya Patel at 1969998900
